rules: Feature runtime cache, temporary data, and evidence logs should live under UserData/CacheData/<Feature>/.
User-facing saved outputs should live under UserData/SavedProject/<Feature>/.
UserData/LogData is reserved for global app logs, crash logs, or launcher-level logs only.
Audio Studio evidence logs must use UserData/CacheData/AudioStudio/logs/.
Do not introduce new UserData top-level roots without updating this contract.
